request.prompt:
日常随行航拍。设计一台便于日常携带的航拍四旋翼。
四个电机各装一副静止、完全展开的双叶螺旋桨，每个电机只装两片桨叶。
目标部位：航拍相机舱与机身，四处臂根与机身。
本次改变：沿机身纵向展开相机舱与主体的比例关系，四处臂根的轮廓顺着机臂延伸。
保持：机头朝画面上沿。机载相机水平拍向机头前方。机身冷灰色。
自由项：舱体安装、机身轮廓、臂根曲面和分件。
Propulsion: 5-inch 2-blade propellers; motor tilt 0°.
4 个电机，True X 布局。最大电机中心距设计值 250 mm，相邻夹角从 R1 起顺时针为 90、90、90、90°。
随附正交俯视定位图，机头朝上，红点定位电机轴心。蓝线表示机架连接。
输出正交俯视产品图，制图观察方向从无人机正上方垂直向下，机头指向画面上沿，完整显示所有电机轴心和桨叶。保持各轴心在定位图画幅内的归一化位置和留白。
浅色中性背景，照片级工业产品设计渲染，柔和棚拍侧光与接触阴影，画面无辅助线、刻度或文字。

configurator_design_fields.source: 开发提案。E002、E025 提醒体量偏好存在差异；舒展、连续是设计推导。

configurator_design_fields.instruction:
探索适合日常携带的整机方案。
保留四个电机轴心、相连的机臂和前向相机。
机身外轮廓、相机安装位置与接合方式、机臂过渡、壳体曲面和分件可探索。

provider_revised_prompt: The square canvas framing, centered placement, and normalized whitespace of <Picture 1> are <Subject 1>. The X-shaped layout of four diagonal motor-axis positions in <Picture 1> is <Subject 2>. The target image replaces the black background, blue connecting lines, and red dots of <Picture 1> with a photorealistic top-down orthographic industrial design rendering of a portable quadcopter drone aligned to <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> against a light neutral studio background. <Subject 1> is fully preserved. <Subject 2> supplies the exact four-corner spatial arrangement transferred to the four upright motors of the new drone. Viewed vertically from directly above with the nose pointing toward the top edge of the frame, the drone features a sleek cool-gray fuselage with a longitudinally extended front camera pod housing a forward-facing gimbal lens aimed horizontally ahead along the central axis. Four tubular arms extend diagonally outward from smoothly blended root fillets that transition into the main body shell, each terminating at one of the four upright 0-degree-tilted brushless motors positioned at <Subject 2> in a true-X configuration with equal 90-degree angular spacing. Each motor shaft is fitted with a stationary, fully unfolded 5-inch two-blade propeller consisting of exactly two slender dark-gray blades, completely visible within the frame without any auxiliary lines, scales, or text. Soft studio side lighting models the matte cool-gray composite surfaces and subtle panel seams, casting gentle contact shadows onto the clean, light neutral surface beneath the airframe.
